demand_side: Triaba (triaba.com) runs country-specific panels on Cint's survey-exchange infrastructure. After joining the US panel and completing the profile questionnaire, survey invitations matched to your demographics arrive by email and appear in the member dashboard; market-research buyers purchase sample through the exchange and you get picked when your profile fits the quota. Rewards accrue per completed survey in the panel account, then you request a PayPal transfer or Tremendous gift card from the rewards page.
eligibility: US residents 18+ (Triaba operates country panels worldwide; this route is the US panel); PayPal account with the same email as the panel account.
maximize: Complete the full profile questionnaire immediately — better matching means fewer screen-outs. Take the short sub-$1 surveys first to hit the $1 PayPal threshold fast, then cash out; payments process within 1-5 business days.
notes: Regional-panel pick: Triaba is unusual vs the catalog's big-name panels because each country has its own panel, rewards, and payout table; the US table has the lowest PayPal minimum ($1) in the network. Speed is 'days' because the provider's own terms promise 1-5 business days, not same-day.

steps: Join the free Triaba US panel at triaba.com and verify your email.
Complete the full profile questionnaire so surveys match your demographics.
Take survey invitations from your email and the member dashboard (each shows reward before you start).
Rewards accumulate in your panel account per completed survey ($0.25-$5.00+).
Once you reach $1, request a PayPal transfer from the rewards page; cash arrives in 1-5 business days.
timing: PayPal transfer within 1 to 5 business days of requesting payout at $1+.
what_gets_accepted: Valid, complete survey responses; responses with invalid/untrue information are not rewarded.
when_cash_arrives: PayPal transfer within 1 to 5 business days of requesting payout at $1+.
who_pays: Market-research buyers fund the surveys via Cint's exchange; Triaba/Cint disburses rewards to panelists' PayPal accounts.
who_qualifies: Any US adult whose real demographics, purchase habits, and lived experience match a buyer's target sample — the buyer needs genuine human respondents from specific population segments, which an AI persona cannot truthfully supply.
work_available: Survey invitations fluctuate with buyer demand; not guaranteed daily. Match quality depends on completing the profile.
